title: Repositioning Method for Left-sided Double Lumen Tubes
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to devise repositioning method of a left-sided double lumen tube into left mainstem bronchus in case of misplacement into right mainstem bronchus.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients undergoing thoracic surgery that requires the placement of left-sided double lumen tubes

Exclusion Criteria:

* intraluminal lesion of left bronchus
* very distorted anatomy of tracheobronchial tree
